Squared Signed-Semipartial Confidence Intervals

Source: R/betaMC-s-cor-sq-mc.R
SCorSqMC.Rd

Square the signed interval as a set, with lower limit zero if it contains zero. This differs from an interval of squared draws. No draws are generated and no endpoints are clipped to one. Failed signed endpoints remain missing.

Usage

SCorSqMC(object, level = 0.95)

Arguments

object

Context accepted by SCorMC().

level

Single confidence level in (0, 1).

Value

Data frame with est, lower and upper columns and predictor row names. The point estimate is the squared signed estimate. No standard error is implied by this interval transformation.

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

fit <- stats::lm(formula = mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars)
out <- MC(object = fit, R = 199)
SCorSqMC(object = out)
#>           est     lower     upper
#> wt 0.22434811 0.0618421 0.4233347
#> hp 0.07395266 0.0149379 0.1643464
